designator.label: pit spikes
designator.description: Sharpened stakes driven into a pit floor. Whoever falls, is pushed or jumps into this cell lands on them: several deep stab wounds, worse for bigger creatures, armour still counts. Walking up to the edge, or moving along the pit floor, is safe. Can only be built at the foot of a sheer drop of 2 m or more (a mod setting), at any depth.

designator.label: wooden ladder
designator.description: A rough ladder hung on one wall of an excavation, like a door between the pit and the ground above. Slid down, people climb down into the pit and back up by it, and haulers fetch what lies on the floor; it works like a prison door: your people climb it, trapped enemies cannot, prisoners only in a prison break. Slid up onto the rim, nobody climbs it.
